verdict.rationale: Airwallex's official CLI is documented to let you script repeatable tasks and wire Airwallex into automated systems. It also has a sandbox default and a --prod opt-in, and a hosted remote MCP endpoint lets agents act from non-terminal environments. However, the documented CLI authorization is OAuth gated to Owner/Admin/Finance Admin roles, and nothing shows a non-interactive, headless credential flow or a CI pipeline setup, so the CI part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless CLI authentication (e.g., API-key or env-var auth for CI), explicit CI pipeline examples or guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: script repeatable tasks, and wire Airwallex into automated systems
Airwallex AgentOS MCP lets agents read and write production Airwallex resources from non-terminal environments
The Airwallex CLI lets you work with your Airwallex account directly from a command line.
